title: poa buckleyana var. elongata
intro: Poa buckleyana var. elongata, commonly known as the Buck's wheat grass or slender poa, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and is believed to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Poa buckleyana var. elongata include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other plant compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential health benefits.
